mapper.insert: insert into chat_room ( room_id, order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, ending_time ) values(#{roomId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{riderId}, #{endingTime});
mapper.select: select room_id, order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, create_time, ending_time, is_complete from chat_room where user_id=#{accountId} order by room_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
select room_id, order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, create_time, ending_time, is_complete from chat_room where merchant_id=#{accountId} order by room_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
select room_id, order_id, user_id, merchant_id, rider_id, create_time, ending_time, is_complete from chat_room where rider_id=#{accountId} order by room_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
mapper.update: update chat_room set is_complete=true where order_id=#{orderId} and is_complete=false
mapper.select: select count(*) from chat_room where room_id=#{roomId} and (user_id=#{accountId} or merchant_id=#{accountId} or rider_id=#{accountId}) #为了配合聊天记录插入的检查,这里检查是否可以插入聊天记录 and is_complete=false and now() < ending_time
